Job Details: 
 
 
 Job Description: 
Since the announcement of the world's first on-chip silicon photonics laser more than a decade ago, Intel continues to lead the industry with cutting-edge technology, silicon photonics integration, and scalable AI systems. Our dedication to advanced development ensures that Intel Silicon Photonics continues to drive future bandwidth growth in data center networks and AI infrastructure, with higher density, better power efficiency, and faster speeds. In the future we will deploy co-packaged silicon photonics optical I/O chip lets to enable higher performance, larger-scale and more power efficient AI systems. We are looking for great talent to accelerate this journey so if you are interested in joining our organization we want to hear from you.
In this position, the selected candidate will join the Corporate Technology Office Team, contributing to its mission of advancing datacenter connectivity and strengthening Intel's competitive edge in scalable AI system design. As an expert in application parallelization, parallel system simulation and HW/SW co-design, the individual will be responsible for exploring the design of electro-optical systems for research and development (R/D) purposes.

Key Responsibilities:
• Define architectures and designs that meet specifications and performance targets for next-generation Intel systems using optical interconnects and advanced electrical networks-on-chip.
• Optimize network-on-chip performance.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to lead overall project development.
• Develop simulation methodologies for scalable electro-photonic systems.
• Advise on the development of test plans for overall system characterization.
• Thoroughly document all design work with review materials and detailed design descriptions.
The ideal applicant should possess excellent oral and written communication skills. 
 
 Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
• Ph.D. in Computer Science or Electrical and Computer Engineering.
• At least 2+ peer-reviewed publications and/or patents in the simulation, design, optimization and implementation of parallel algorithms and network system simulations.
• 6+ months experience with the gem5 simulation system.

 Preferred Qualifications: 
• Strong proficiency CPU and GPU parallelization.
• Extensive design experience using hardware in high-level programming languages (C/C++, python).
• Familiarity with switch fabric architectures and related routing algorithms.
• Proven experience of building end-to-end simulation frameworks bridging electronics, and photonics in an overall system design.
